title: Strange lights over the San Juan coal mine
place_text: San Juan coal mine, New Mexico

tellings.quote: I also spoke to an Aztec local who has seen strange lights darting above the San Juan coal mine right by where he worked

plain: A local man from Aztec, New Mexico, Brett Lanner, says he has seen strange lights darting above the San Juan coal mine, right by where he worked. Michels says he spoke to him himself, and he passes the account on in a 2026 episode about a reported crash of a craft carrying alien bodies in that area, as a sign that odd things are still seen there.
